notes_for_editor: Height is the 53-foot tower figure converted to metres (16.2 m). Elevation 6,226 ft comes from idahofirelookouts.com and has no schema key. The brief's county 'Idaho' is the name firelookout.org uses; left unchanged. A search returned a Shearer Guard Station in the Selway-Bitterroot, which is a different structure and is not used. No source read gives the cause of the 1973 destruction.
